DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00101
⌈Eth_Init() shall be called before Eth_GetPhcTime().⌋
In case the Com-Stack is distributed across several partitions, the Ethernet stack could
reside in a different partition than the StbM module calling Eth_GetPhcTime (via Eth
If_GetPhcTime) API, means the call of Eth_GetPhcTime could happen in another par-
tition.
